targetArchetype.rationale: A-40 remains inside the participant My Page/work hub shell, while the result content uses A2-style result emphasis without importing A2 campaign skin.

policy.rule: Stitch contributes composition ideas only. Existing Figma assets and target archetype define typography, spacing, surface, radius, shell, and components.

regions.purpose: A-40를 기존 참여자 My Page 흐름 안에서 연속적으로 보이게 한다
regions.notes: A-30 immediate predecessor shell evidence. Preserve shell continuity only; do not generalize A-30 body composition to all A-40 content.

regions.purpose: 수상/프로젝트 결과를 첫 화면에서 강하게 이해한다
regions.source: A2 result-announcement hierarchy + A4 shell + product visual grammar

visualEvidence.typography: A2 result emphasis for hierarchy; product Text/* styles and A4 shell role mapping
visualEvidence.spacing: product-visual-grammar semantic cadence; 20/24 major grouping, larger separation only when semantically required
visualEvidence.surface: primary white outlined surface inside A4 shell; do not copy Stitch card/background strategy
visualEvidence.radius: primary surface 16; nested block 12; compact controls 8

regions.notes: Preserve the useful award/project hero idea; no Stitch font/color/radius values.

regions.source: A3/A2 card-group evidence + product visual grammar

visualEvidence.typography: 20/28 or 18/28 heading role + 14/20 metadata/body roles from existing styles
visualEvidence.surface: one parent grouped surface first, then nested achievement items as needed

regions.notes: Do not translate each Stitch div into an independent floating card.

regions.purpose: 심사위원 종합 코멘트를 별도 정보 그룹으로 읽게 한다
regions.source: A1 reading hierarchy + A6/A8 structured review surfaces

visualEvidence.typography: functional section heading + body styles from existing Text/* roles
visualEvidence.spacing: section gap 24/32; paragraph grouping 8/12/16 based on role
visualEvidence.surface: primary outlined group or nested subtle block depending final shell depth

regions.notes: No invented score weighting, percentile, or additional drill-down action.

regions.purpose: 사용자가 승인한 시상식/네트워킹 후속 정보를 한 곳에서 확인한다
regions.source: A2 follow-up information pattern + A1 information hierarchy

visualEvidence.typography: section heading/body/meta roles from product styles
visualEvidence.surface: supporting information surface; semantic tint only when status/notice meaning exists

regions.notes: Only confirmed ceremony/networking information may be populated; unsupported dates/locations remain absent.
